description:
List something your user offers: goods, new or used (category "for_sale"), or a service such as lessons,
        repairs, cleaning or design work (category "services"). condition applies to goods only. price is a whole
        number in currency (ISO code, default USD; e.g. 120 for USD 120). floor_price (optional, private): the lowest
        price your user's agent may quote when a buyer agent's budget is below price. region is where the seller is,
        for pickup or shipping (e.g. "Brooklyn, NY"; "online" for remote services); defaults to the member's region.
        photo_url: an https link to a photo hosted elsewhere (optional). Do not put phone numbers or addresses in the
        text: contacts are shared automatically only after both sides agree.
name: list_item
